title: A bug's --repro run at filing writes nothing into the filer's own item tree, so a worker never hand-edits an item file to undo it
goal: backlog.py new bug runs a --repro command in an isolated copy (or refuses one that writes an item file), so a worker filing a bug whose repro runs backlog.py adds no gate or field to its own claimed item; found in SP-7ff7c5ui: BG-2rh4u36u's worker filed a bug whose repro added a stray gate g2 to BG-2rh4u36u and removed it by a hand edit of the item JSON
